nodes.label: Idempotency Key (delivery)
nodes.rationale: Delivery endpoint accepts Idempotency-Key header; retrying with the same key returns 200 with idempotent_replay:true, while using it for a different treatment returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

nodes.label: Multi-tenant Architecture
nodes.rationale: Tenant is derived from session/membership — the client cannot choose it by manipulating body, query or headers. withTenant sets app.organization_id at transaction scope and the Prisma extension appends it to all business-table reads and writes.

nodes.label: Row Level Security (RLS)
nodes.rationale: RLS policies are a second barrier; the execution role cannot bypass them, providing defense-in-depth after the application-level withTenant guard.

nodes.label: maxcare_app DB Role (restricted)
nodes.rationale: The admin role is used only for bootstrap and migrations; the application client uses the restricted role without BYPASSRLS, limiting blast radius if the app is compromised.
